name: What site conditions can turn an apartment project into a problem project?

mainEntity.name: Which hidden site issues most often create surprises during apartment construction in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: Which hidden site issues most often create surprises during apartment construction in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several site conditions can turn an apartment project into a problem project in Los Angeles. Poor soil, slope, drainage issues, utility conflicts, limited access, and demolition surprises are among the most common. These conditions affect excavation, foundations, hauling, shoring, and schedule sequencing, often before the structure itself is even underway. Because these issues are often hidden at the start, early due diligence is critical. A site may look straightforward but still require expensive foundation work or utility relocations. The best way to reduce surprises is to investigate the lot thoroughly before final pricing. If a project is in a dense or older neighborhood, owners should be especially cautious about assuming standard construction conditions. Hidden site issues are one of the main reasons apartment bids change after work begins.
